issue.title: The active accent color is not communicated
issue.body_value:
Problem/Motivation

If you are getting to admin/appearance/settings/default_admin the active accent color is not apparent. In Safari you also don't see any outline at all for the active accent color when you are changing it (safari.mp4), while in Edge and Firefox you see an outline after you have selected and clicked your new desired accent color (edge.mp4, firefox.mp4). But that outline is hidden again in those two browsers as soon as you are changing any other setting on the page by click.

Steps to reproduce

Go to admin/appearance/settings/default_admin and try to figure out which of the accent color circles is the active one.

Proposed resolution

Show an outline for the active accent color persistently.

I’ve opened a merge request that adds a persistent visual indicator for the selected accent color while preserving the keyboard focus indicator. It updates the PostCSS source and compiled CSS. I manually tested the selection in light and dark modes.
